preconditions.description: The number of needles K is an integer between 1 and 50000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(c, int) and 1 <= c < 1000 for c in all_coords)
preconditions.description: All coordinate values (x, y, z) for every needle endpoint are integers between 1 and 999 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(p1 != p2 for p1, p2 in needle_endpoints)
preconditions.description: For every needle, the two endpoint triples are distinct.

preconditions.expression: len(set(tuple(sorted([tuple(p1), tuple(p2)])) for p1, p2 in needle_endpoints)) == K
preconditions.description: All K needles are represented by distinct sets of triples.

postconditions.description: The first output line is 'True closed chains' if and only if there exists a sequence of k >= 3 distinct needles forming a true closed chain (a cycle in the 3D graph where consecutive needles share a 3D endpoint and the last connects back to the first).

The second output line is 'Floor closed chains' if and only if there exists a sequence of k >= 3 distinct needles forming a floor closed chain (a cycle in the 2D shadow graph where consecutive needle shadows share a 2D endpoint, the last connects back to the first, and all k needle shadows are distinct).

postconditions.expression: len(output_lines) == 2 and all(isinstance(line, str) for line in output_lines)
postconditions.description: The output consists of exactly two lines, each being a string.
